purpose: Reusable hierarchy navigation and host-owned operations for database and filesystem trees

operator_scope.integration: Later Handshake adapter; preserve active WP012 refactor and source files
operator_scope.unlink: Cabinet requires no Notes, Forgejo or HandForge dependencies; application-wide Notes unlinking requires its own integration inventory

requirements.requirement: Default Rust core has no GUI, database, network, filesystem or forge dependency
Optional native egui renderer exposes stable diagnostic and accessibility identities
Folder-plus toolbar icon has tooltip and accessible name; no visible add-folder text
Folder and leaf multi-entry drag intentions support inside, before, after and root destinations
Drop validation uses complete canonical hierarchy, capabilities and revisions; rejects cycles and stale context
Create and rename use inline editing with Enter commit and Escape cancellation
Keyboard navigation, range/toggle selection and reveal retain identity rather than row indexes
Refresh retains live expansion and selection; context changes clear private interaction and history state
Valid hierarchy is not truncated at five or twenty levels
Manual, name ascending/descending and created/modified sorting are explicit
Host acknowledgments own durable effects and compensation; failed writes retain canonical data
Filtering retains matching ancestor paths without claiming complete search of unloaded membership
Failed, unloaded and loading children remain distinct; lazy-load intentions reach host
Headless executable example, interface tests and rendered UI inspection support no-context operation
Peak is a standalone subcrate: hover name first, colored tags second; longer hover expands resizable content
Peak requests are independent of durable operations and fenced by scope, generation, context, resource, occurrence and entry revision
All text source languages can preview as bounded plain text; optional codecs supply common images and camera RAW without universal model claims
Ellipsis and right-click share host-owned duplicate, download, rename, move, parent, copy reference, properties, tags and color actions
Tags use stable resource membership identities; tag and occurrence colors support hue/saturation wheel plus validated RGB hex drafts
Persistent tree sort default and direct-folder overrides are distinct; changing default preserves explicit overrides
Size, type, creation and modification sorts expose both directions; missing metadata sorts last
Host can configure and persist all settings; optional serde supports save/reload and settings changes are emitted
Default single click opens after configured double-click interval; double click renames without first opening; alternate select/double-open mode available
Decoder workers and capabilities belong to host; unavailable HEIC/AVIF/JPEG-XL or camera compression is explicit
Persistent entry/children indexes and cached row projection prevent repeated full-tree work on unchanged frames
Only viewport rows and overscan construct native controls; selection lookup is constant time; width measurement is cached
Atomic revision-checked delta batches update canonical entries and preserve unaffected navigation
Paged child loading supports fenced continuation and retry; incomplete-tree moves require explicit host preflight and revalidation
Unloaded folder preferences survive partial snapshots; confirmed deletions remove obsolete preferences
Peak scheduling bounds queued/active requests and cached bytes; obsolete work retains active ownership until acknowledged completion or stop
Large-tree benchmarks measure 10k,100k,1m varied trees; diagnostics distinguish canonical loaded entries, projected rows and rendered viewport rows
Move destinations show full paths; pinned folders, breadcrumbs and quick path navigation use stable identities
Loaded-only filtering and host whole-workspace search are explicit and stale results are fenced
Visibility exclusions and host watcher exclusions are separate persisted settings; hiding does not claim watcher shutdown
Bulk operations expose host-owned progress and bounded recovery without assuming a failed or cancelled action has stopped
Independent dependency and code inspection rejects dead scaffolding, redundant constructions and unused public integration paths

sources.pattern: Inline naming, keyboard selection, drag movement, undoable host operations
Separate drag target validation, feedback and durable drop execution
Controlled host mutations and canonical sibling ordering
Toolkit-native tree events, drop markers, keyboard and visible-row culling
Selection/focus distinction and tree keyboard conventions
Empty default feature set and additive optional GUI dependency
Focusable interactive hover content uses nonmodal dialog semantics
Common raster codecs; HEIC and RAW need distinct providers
Dimension/allocation guards are not hard process memory isolation
Rust-native RAW decoding and embedded previews, model-specific support, unstable API
RawDevelop fallback is explicit; embedded preview first
Broad model-specific RAW support; native adapter remains host extensibility option
Defaults and explicit scoped overrides are distinct
Construct viewport range instead of every expanded row
Watcher resource limits and exclusions differ from display hiding
Started blocking decoders retain ownership until actual completion; abort is not stop proof

local_reuse: Handpick effect-free intention and generation-fence patterns
Host-owned context menu, theme and accessibility integration
research_basis.selected: Dependency-free indexed mechanics with cached projections, optional egui viewport renderer, atomic versioned updates and host-owned loading/search/effects; Peak uses effect-free bounded scheduling and byte-budgeted caching
rejected: React or webview rendering in native Handshake
Eager replacement during WP012 active consolidation
research_basis.candidate_limit: egui_ltreeview not adopted wholesale because Cabinet requires host-neutral revisions, operation history and explicit accessible identities

risks.risk: Unloaded descendants permit an invalid move
risks.control: Reject moves unless hierarchy_complete; host rechecks full ancestry and permissions

risks.risk: Late delivery exposes old account or workspace contents
risks.control: Scope/generation/context fences and atomic snapshot admission
Pending operation retains canonical content until host acknowledgment

risks.risk: New widget bypasses shared global selection/theme/menu owners
risks.control: Adapter composition; no app-specific services in core

risks.risk: Undo corrupts data changed by another actor
risks.control: Opaque host compensation tokens; host validates conflict and revocation at execution

examples.headless: PASS: in-memory host-confirmed move and undo
examples.host_workflows: PASS: paging/retry, move preflight/grant, search, recovery and partial preferences
examples.settings_persistence: PASS: actual JSON save/reload; folder override survives default change

results.clippy: PASS: default and all-feature libraries with dead_code and unused_imports denied
results.clippy_remaining: Two existing nonfunctional UTF16 decoder style suggestions

visual.renderer: Actual egui tessellation software-rasterized at 900x600; no native window/GPU launched
visual.result: PASS: root and independent inspector found tree, Download menu, wheel/hex/Apply and expanded Peak name/tags/text readable
visual.fixture_guards: Menu/color require expected controls; reveal scrolling settles before clicks

independent_review.dependency: PASS: no new runtime dependencies or orphan public integration paths
independent_review.independent_checks: Inspector-authored regressions executed by root; inspector directly read final proof log, benchmark JSONL and native renders
counterfactuals: Cancelled worker ownership prevents premature concurrency reuse
Delta revision admission prevents stale mutations
Scope cache clearing prevents account A-B-A private replay
independent_review.residual_uncertainty: Cold loaded-entry traversal and large canonical memory; production adapters/storage/worker isolation unproven

benchmark.instrumentation: Requested Rust heap/allocation calls, not RSS; 20 frames/case with 10 stationary and 10 scroll inputs

environment.contention: Concurrent external work and memory pressure observed; machine/source/feature-specific results

unproven: Physical filesystem effects and watcher ownership
Other hardware, sorts, dense overrides or arbitrary-depth benchmark fixtures
proof.limits: Cold projection/filtering and hierarchy validation traverse loaded entries; million-entry updates can take seconds. Prefer host paging; no universal capacity or Handshake acceptance claim.
